posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked:
From 1:33:45 of a recent Tactics stream from PAX, there was what seemed(?) like a new ad for the video game.  (Maybe it is actually not new; I always tended to skip the gaps between matches previously, so I wouldn't have seen it if it was shown before.)  The ad had voice acting for Baron Blade, something I've never heard before.  It was quite heavily accented.  There was also some new art, showing Baron Blade looking at a hologram of his moonfall plan, showing estimated casualties of 5.8 billion people.  Anyway, it made me wonder if there's going to be voice acting added to the game, whether in general (maybe for the "flavorQuotes" value seen here?) or just for the eventual campaign mode.  Maybe extra cutscenes too, given the new art.  Very exciting!

Baron Blade's voice-acted dialogue was as follows: "You claim you fight for freedom, but yours is a legacy of destruction, a legacy of death.  It matters not who you surround yourself with, Mr. Parsons.  No nations, no heroes, no sentinels you can assemble can hope to stand in the face of the inevitable.  The moon is a constant reminder of the passage of time.  Is it not fitting that now the end of your time is also the end of the moon's time?  I will leave your world in ruins!  Whatever remains will be mine."
